The '''cone sock''' was a chemical-based [[Clothing/Legends|garment]]<ref name="NEGTAS" /> created by the [[Gotal/Legends|Gotal]] entrepreneur [[Alyn Rae]]<ref name="CSWE Alyn">{{CSWECite|III|73|Rae, Alyn}}</ref> and a group of [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]]<ref name="NEGTAS" /> by around [[29 ABY/Legends|29 ABY]].<ref name="NEGTAS Date" /> Cone socks were designed to be worn over the sensitive [[Cones|receptor cones]] atop a Gotal's head in order to block out irritating electromagnetic signals caused by [[Droid/Legends|droids]] or types of technology.<ref name="CSWE Alyn">{{CSWECite|III|73|Rae, Alyn}}</ref> They were expensive and initially only worn by wealthy Gotals, but their practicality saw them grow in popularity.<ref name="NEGTAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Cone socks were first mentioned in the [[2006]] reference book ''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]'', written by [[Ann Margaret Lewis (real person)|Ann Margaret Lewis]] and [[Helen Keier]].<ref name="NEGTAS" />
